title: The War in the Feed
author: Peter Bach
content:
One recent early evening, airstrikes hit southern Lebanon. In the hours that
followed, videos purportedly showing this circulated on TikTok, Telegram and
X. Had it not been real, it might have resembled a scene from a war film: jets
overhead, explosions echoing across hills, smoke rising fast, hidden forces
exchanging fire across a frontier. But […]
